root: ^Elder Oozy, what happened? Why are you in this condition?

main: ^Yes, I have. But that's not important right now. Please tell me who did this to you.
^It's... an unknown force. Something dark has taken over the island.
^An unknown force? But how? We are slimes. How can we be affected by something like this?
^I do not know, my child. We’ve been running from it for half a year. We don’t know what it is or why this is happening.
^I don’t know, I’m the only survivor from the group I was with, and I don't know how much time I have left.
^Please don’t say stuff like that; I’m going to save you. Wait just a moment; I’ll give you a potion, and you’ll be good as new.
^Jelly, listen to me. The corruption... it's spreading faster than we can understand. Many tried to fight it, but... it was too strong. The once peaceful village... is now a nightmare.
^But there must be a way to stop it! There has to be some clue, something we missed.

^There were whispers... of a dark force... an artifact that holds unimaginable power. It could be the source... or the key to ending this curse. But we couldn't find it. You must... you must be careful, Jelly. The island is not what it used to be.
^I won't give up. I will find this artifact, and I will save our village. I promise.
^Be strong... my child. The fate of... the village... rests with you...
^I will not let this be the end. I will find the source of this evil and restore our land. For you, Elder Oozy. For everyone.
